title: 第六章 第一次以命换命，我没有任何犹豫-《无CP废土：基建养出全》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一、暗处

    手电筒的光在车间里晃，扫过离心机、管道、积水。

    两个人，都是男性。走在前面那个矮胖，手里举着老式手电筒，另一只手提着砍刀。后面那个高瘦，端着一把****，枪口斜指地面。

    “这破地方有什么好搜的？全是铁锈味。“矮胖的抱怨了一句，声音在空旷的车间里撞出回音。

    “少废话。老大的命令，每个角落都看一遍。找到东西有赏，找不到回去挨鞭子。“高瘦的语气冷冰冰的，不像对同伴说话，更像在训一条狗。

    矮胖哼了一声，手电筒的光扫过离心机，停了一秒。林霜把脸埋进臂弯，遮住反光。光移开了。

    “没什么东西。走吧。“矮胖转身往回走。

    高瘦却没动。他站在原地，目光在车间里扫了一圈，然后慢慢走到离心机旁边，用枪管敲了敲机器外壳。

    “咣——咣——“

    金属敲击声在车间里回荡。林霜贴着离心机底座，肚子贴着地面，呼吸慢而浅，用腹部带动。右手握石斧，左手撑地，膝盖微屈。光再近一寸，她就弹出去砍脚踝。

    高瘦蹲下来，把手电筒照向机器底座。

    林霜右手握得更紧。

    手电筒的光在缝隙边缘停了一下——然后移开了。

    高瘦站起来，拍了拍裤子上的灰。

    “走吧。“

    两个人朝楼梯走去，脚步声越来越远。

    林霜在离心机下面又待了三十秒，确认他们没有折返，才从缝隙里爬出来。后背全是冷汗，不是体力消耗，是肾上腺素。这呼吸控制，是废墟里练的。叙利亚的废墟，老太太教她的。

    “系统，扫描周边热源分布。“

    “扫描中。管道入口方向：热源信号3个，距离15米，呈包围态势。管道深处：热源信号2个，正在向上移动。建议宿主立即向管道深处撤离，避开正面冲突。“

    林霜从卫衣里掏出那袋原料药——约两斤庆大霉素结晶块，用塑料袋包了三层，外面又缠了一层从车间找来的塑料膜。她把原料药袋用绳子绑在胸前，两手空出来，方便攀爬。

    然后她沿着墙根，摸黑向排水管道的入口走去。

    铁栅栏还在地上，管道口黑洞洞的，透出一股腐臭味。林霜先把脚伸进去，然后是身体，双手撑着管道内壁，一点一点往下滑。

    管道还是湿的，但她进来时鞋是干的，现在沾了泥，更滑。她差点整个人滑下去，幸亏右手抓住了管道口边缘的一个螺栓孔，才稳住。

    她重新调整姿势，面朝上，背朝下，用脚后跟蹬着管道内壁，慢慢下滑。这样虽然慢，但能控制速度，也不会发出太大声音。

    管道里的水越来越深，漫过了她的腰。

    走了大约三分钟，她听到了一种声音。

    不是流水声，不是管道共振声。

    是钢管敲击声。

    从管道入口的方向传来。

    一声，很短，然后停了。又一声。苏琳在发信号，但节奏不对——不是约定的“三短一长“，只有两声，像是被打断的。

    然后是闷响，像有人摔倒。接着枪声，三声点射。

    自动步枪，三发点射。收割者在上面。

    林霜的心一沉。

    她在管道里，离出口至少还有五分钟的路程。她没有办法加速——管道太窄，弯腰走是最大速度，再快就会滑倒。

    她只能继续走。

    枪声又响了。这次更密，像有人在扫射。

    林霜加快了下滑的速度，不再顾忌声音。脚后跟用力蹬着管道内壁，水花四溅，金属摩擦声在管道里嗡嗡作响。

    五分钟的路程，她用了三分钟。

    【苏琳视角补充】

    苏琳守在管道入口外的洼地里，数着时间。

    二十五分钟了。林霜还没出来。

    她握紧砍刀，盯着药厂方向。收割者的越野车还停在前门，铁锤帮的人在厂里进进出出。没有异常。

    三十分钟到了。

    她想起约定——“三十分钟后，不管我出不出来，你都回地下室“——但腿像钉在地上。她不能走。

    她拖着左腿，拄着钢管，向管道入口靠近了几步，想听听里面的动静。就这几步，暴露了她的位置。

    两个收割者从药厂后门绕出来巡逻，手电筒光扫到她脸上。

    “有人！“

    苏琳拔刀就砍，砍中第一个人的肩膀。但第二个人从背后扑上来，膝盖压住她左腿骨裂处，剧痛让她眼前发黑。第三个人赶来，枪托砸在她后脑上。

    她昏过去前，听到有人在喊：“留个活口，问问还有没有同伙。“

    二、冲出去

    管道出口的光线越来越亮。

    不是阳光——废土的阳光没有这么亮。是手电筒和车灯的光。

    林霜爬到出口边缘，没有立刻出去，先探出半个头观察。

    污水站后面的洼地里，停着一辆车。

    不是掠夺者的改装车，不是铁锤帮的破皮卡。是一辆军绿色的装甲越野车，车身上涂着红色的骷髅标志——收割者的车。车旁边站着三个人，驾驶室里还坐着两个，另一个在车头前抽烟——药厂门口的六个收割者，五个在这辆车主附近，剩下一个守另一辆车。

    地上躺着一个人。

    苏琳。

    她的双手被反绑在背后，嘴巴被布条勒住，左腿上的固定层板被扯掉了，整个人被按得跪在地上。头低垂着，看不出是死是活。

    林霜盯着苏琳垂着的头，数了三秒心跳。

    苏琳还活着。她得把她弄出来。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

1. Dark place

The light of the flashlight swayed in the workshop, scanning the centrifuges, pipes, and accumulated water.

​​Two people, both men.The short and fat man walking in front held an old-fashioned flashlight in one hand and a machete in the other.The tall and thin man in the back was holding a gun, with the muzzle pointing diagonally at the ground.

"What's there to search in this wretched place? It smells like rust." The short and fat man complained, his voice echoing in the empty workshop.

"Stop talking nonsense. Read every corner of the boss's orders. If you find something, you will be rewarded. If you can't find it, you will be whipped." The tall and thin tone was cold, not like talking to a companion, but more like training a dog.

Chunky snorted, and the light of the flashlight swept across the centrifuge and paused for a second.Lin Shuang buried her face in her arms to block the reflection.The light moved away.

"There's nothing. Let's go." Chubby turned around and walked back.

He was tall and thin but did not move.He stood there and glanced around the workshop, then slowly walked to the centrifuge and tapped the machine casing with the barrel of his gun.

"Bang——bang——"

The sound of metal tapping echoed in the workshop.Lin Shuang pressed against the base of the centrifuge, with her belly on the ground, breathing slowly and shallowly, using her belly to drive.Hold the stone ax in your right hand, support the ground with your left hand, and bend your knees slightly.If the light was even an inch closer, she would pop out and chop at the ankle.

The tall and thin man squatted down and shined the flashlight at the base of the machine.

Lin Shuang clenched her right hand tighter.

The flashlight’s light paused at the edge of the gap—and then moved away.

The tall and thin man stood up and patted the dust on his pants.

"Let's go."

The two people walked towards the stairs, the footsteps getting farther and farther.

Lin Shuang stayed under the centrifuge for another thirty seconds to confirm that they had not turned back before climbing out of the gap.My back was covered in cold sweat, not from physical exertion but from adrenaline.This breathing control was practiced in the ruins.The ruins of Syria, the old lady taught her.

"The system scans the surrounding heat source distribution."

"Scanning in progress. Pipe entrance direction: 3 heat source signals, 15 meters away, in a surrounding situation. Deep in the pipe: 2 heat source signals, moving upward. It is recommended that the host evacuate deep into the pipe immediately to avoid direct conflict. "

Lin Shuang took out the bag of raw material medicine - about two kilograms of gentamicin crystals - from his sweater, wrapped it three times in a plastic bag, and wrapped it with a layer of plastic film from the workshop.She tied the bag of raw materials to her chest with a rope, leaving her hands free for easy climbing.

Then she walked along the base of the wall in the dark toward the entrance of the drainage pipe.

The iron fence is still on the ground, and the pipe mouth is dark, exuding a putrid smell.Lin Shuang put her feet in first, then her body, holding the inner wall of the pipe with both hands, and slid down bit by bit.

The pipe was still wet, but her shoes were dry when she came in, and now they were muddy and slippery.She almost slipped down, but fortunately she caught a bolt hole on the edge of the pipe mouth with her right hand to stabilize herself.

She readjusted her position, facing up and back down, pushing her heels on the inner wall of the pipe, and slowly slid down.Although this is slow, it can control the speed and not make too much noise.

The water in the pipe became deeper and deeper, covering her waist.

After walking for about three minutes, she heard a sound.

It’s not the sound of running water or the resonance of pipes.

It’s the sound of steel pipes knocking.

Coming from the direction of the pipe entrance.

There was a short sound, and then it stopped.Another sound.Su Lin was sending signals, but the rhythm was wrong—not the agreed "three short and one long", but only two sounds, which seemed to be interrupted.

Then there was a muffled sound, like someone falling.Then there was gunfire, three bursts.

Automatic rifle, three-round burst fire.The Reaper is on top.

Lin Shuang's heart sank.

She was in the pipe, at least five minutes away from the exit.There was no way for her to speed up - the pipe was too narrow, and bending down was the maximum speed, and she would slip if she went any faster.

She could only keep walking.

The gunfire rang out again.This time it was denser, like someone was shooting.

Lin Shuang accelerated his descent, no longer worrying about the sound.The heel pushed hard against the inner wall of the pipe, water splashed everywhere, and the sound of metal friction buzzed in the pipe.

It took her three minutes for the five-minute journey.

【Su Lin’s perspective added】

Su Lin stood in the depression outside the entrance of the pipeline, counting the time.

It’s been twenty-five minutes.Lin Shuang hasn't come out yet.

She gripped the machete tightly and stared in the direction of the pharmaceutical factory.The Reaper's SUV was still parked at the front door, and people from the Hammer Gang were coming in and out of the factory.Nothing unusual.

Thirty minutes are up.

She remembered the agreement - "In thirty minutes, whether I come out or not, you will go back to the basement" - but her legs felt like they were nailed to the ground.She can't leave.

She dragged her left leg, leaning on the steel pipe, and took a few steps closer to the entrance of the pipe, wanting to hear what was going on inside.Just these few steps revealed her position.

Two reapers came out from the back door of the pharmaceutical factory to patrol, and the flashlight shined on her face.

"There's someone!"

Su Lin drew her sword and struck, hitting the first man on the shoulder.But the second person rushed up from behind and pressed his knee against the cracked bone in her left leg. The severe pain made her eyes black.A third man came and hit her on the back of the head with the butt of his gun.

Before she passed out, she heard someone shouting: "Keep yourself alive and ask if you have any accomplices."

2. Rush out

The light at the pipe exit is getting brighter and brighter.

It’s not sunlight—the sunlight in the wasteland is not that bright.It’s the light of flashlights and car lights.

Lin Shuang climbed to the edge of the exit. Instead of going out immediately, he stuck out half of his head to observe.

There is a car parked in the depression behind the sewage station.

It’s not a modified car from the Predator, it’s not a pickup truck from the Hammers.It is a military green armored off-road vehicle with a red skull logo painted on the body - the Reaper's vehicle.There were three people standing next to the car, two more were sitting in the cab, and another was smoking in front of the car. There were six reapers at the entrance of the pharmaceutical factory, five of them were near the owner of the car, and the remaining one was guarding the other car.

There is a person lying on the ground.

Su Lin.

Her hands were tied behind her back, her mouth was strangled with a piece of cloth, the fixed layer on her left leg was torn off, and she was forced to kneel on the ground.His head was lowered, and he couldn't tell whether he was dead or alive.

Lin Shuang stared at Su Lin's lowered head and counted her heartbeats for three seconds.

Su Lin is still alive.She had to get her out.
Page (1/3)
title_en: Chapter 6: The first time I exchanged my life for my life, I didn’t hesitate at all - "CP-free Wasteland: Infrastructure Builds the Whole"
